text: In 1822, a man sold land... in a country that didn't exist.
He called it Poyais. And he called himself its ruler.
He had a three-hundred-fifty-five-page guidebook... a flag... and his own money.
In London, he launched a two hundred thousand pound Poyais loan.
Families bought land. Men bought jobs. A cobbler became "Shoemaker to the Princess."
Then they swapped their gold... for Poyais dollars.
Two ships sailed. About two hundred and fifty people.
They found no capital. No farms. Just jungle.
Fewer than fifty ever came home.
And MacGregor? A French court tried him... and let him go.
He died in Venezuela, with a military pension and a hero's funeral.
Everything he sold was fake. Only the money he took was real.
